question: The first and second members, respectively, of the ketone homologous series are:
solution:
The correct answer is __**propanone, butanone**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The first and second members of the **ketone **homologous series are **propanone and butanone**, respectively.
 
• A homologous series is a group of organic compounds that have a similar general formula, show a gradual change in physical properties, and have similar chemical properties.
 
• In the case of ketones, the simplest ketone is **propanone **(commonly known as **acetone**), followed by **butanone **(commonly known as **methyl ethyl ketone**).
 
• Ketones are characterized by the presence of a **carbonyl group (C=O)** bonded to two carbon atoms.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The general formula for ketones is** CₙH₂ₙO**.
 
• Ketones are widely used as solvents and in the production of various chemicals.
 
• The naming of ketones follows the IUPAC nomenclature, where the suffix "-one" is added to the parent alkane chain.
 
• **Propanone **(acetone) is a common solvent used in **nail polish remover and as a cleaning agent**.
 
• **Butanone **(methyl ethyl ketone) is used as a** solvent in the production of plastics, textiles, and other chemicals**.
